sn11.9:1.2: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave sambahulā isayo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu sammanti || || 3.
sn11.9:1.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Sakko ca devānam indo Vepacitti ca asurindo yena te isayo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || || 4.
sn11.9:1.4: Atha kho bhikkhave Vepacitti asurindo aṭaliyo upāhanā ārohitvā khaggam olaggetvā chattena dhāriyamānena aggadvārena assamam pavisitvā te isayo sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme apavyāmato karitvā atikkami || || 5.
sn11.9:1.5: Atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo aṭaliyo upāhanā orohitvā khaggam aññesaṃ datvā chattam apānametvā dvāreneva assamam pavisitvā te isayo sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme anuvātaṃ pañjaliko namassamāno aṭṭhāsi || || 6.
sn11.9:1.6: Atha kho bhikkhave te isayo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā Sakkam devānam indaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsiṃsu || ||
sn11.9:3.5: na hettha devā patikkūlasaññino ti || || 1. Sāvatthi || || 2.
